title: Olivia Rodrigo Shares Second Holiday Song ‘Miss This Christmas’ on Amazon Music
summary: The new track follows the pop star’s debut holiday song, “Take Me Home (4 Christmas).”
content: Olivia Rodrigo is keeping the holiday spirit alive with another festive release. Just weeks after making her Christmas debut with “Take Me Home (4 Christmas),” the 23-year-old pop star has returned with a second holiday offering, “Miss This Christmas,” exclusively through Amazon Music . Related Olivia Rodrigo ‘Over the Moon’ About ‘you seem pretty sad’ Grammy Nods: ‘I Love This Album So Much’ Watch Olivia Rodrigo Go Behind the Scenes ‘(4 Christmas)’ With Ben Marshall & Cynthia Nixon Olivia Rodrigo’s ‘Stupid Song’ Hits No. 1 on Billboard’s Pop Airplay Chart Rodrigo debuted “Miss This Christmas” live during her concert at Nashville’s Bridgestone Arena on Monday (Nov. 23), introducing it to the crowd as a “really sad Christmas song” and noting that “no one’s ever really heard it before,” according to Rolling Stone . The track was also included as the B-side on the vinyl edition of “Take Me Home (4 Christmas),” which arrived in early November. The holiday tune peaked at No. 32 on the Billboard Hot 100 in mid-November. While “Take Me Home (4 Christmas)” leans into festive pop with a nostalgic feel, “Miss This Christmas” takes a more melancholy approach, exploring the heartache of missing someone during the holiday season. “Happy Christmas to the lonely/ Broken hearts that feel just like me,” Rodrigo sings before adding, “Yeah, next year’s gonna look real different/ Tell your folks I’ll miss their Christmas.” The song was co-written with Dan Nigro. The new release arrives during a particularly busy stretch for Rodrigo, who earned seven nominations at the 2027 Grammy Awards, including album of the year for her third studio album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love . “I am over the moon!!!!!” Rodrigo wrote on Instagram after the Grammy noms were announced. “I love this album so much and for it to be recognized in this way is the biggest honor.” You seem pretty sad for a girl so in love also recently earned its fifth nonconsecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200.

title: The Killers’ Dave Keuning Says He Survived a Major Stroke: ‘By Some Miracle I Am Fine’
summary: The guitarist says doctors gave him a 40% chance of survival — and that the first thing he checked after surgery was whether he could still play.
content: The Killers guitarist Dave Keuning has revealed he suffered a major stroke two weeks ago and went straight into surgery. Keuning, 50, shared the news in an Instagram post on Thursday (Nov. 26), writing that a blood clot had cut off the blood supply to the right side of his brain. “Two weeks ago, I had a major stroke, and thanks to my wife acting fast, I went straight to the hospital and into surgery,” he wrote. “The first hour after a stroke is critical when it comes to getting to the hospital.” “By the time I arrived at the hospital, I was blind in one eye and had lost function on my left side,” Keuning continued, adding that even then he didn’t realize he was having a stroke. Doctors gave him a 40% chance of survival and told him to expect lasting disabilities, he said, “but by some miracle I am fine.” “And yes I can play guitar just as good as before,” he wrote. “It was the first thing I checked when I woke up from surgery.” “I feel extremely fortunate that I am alive and well, and that I can use my hands and feet and talk just like before,” he added. “I am thankful for my wife, my son, my daughter, and all of my bandmates, who I feel closer to than ever.” A founding member of the Las Vegas band, Keuning stepped back from touring with the Killers in 2017 and has stayed off the road since, though he returned to the studio for 2021’s Pressure Machine . He has also released two solo albums under the name Keuning: Prismism (2019) and A Mild Case of Everything (2021). The Killers earned their first No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 2017’s Wonderful Wonderful and have notched eight No. 1 albums on the Official U.K. Albums Chart, most recently with 2023’s Rebel Diamonds . Their 2004 debut, Hot Fuss , produced “Mr. Brightside,” which in 2021 became the first song to log 260 weeks on the U.K. singles chart. Brandon Flowers released his third solo album, Thrasher , in August, and has said he expects the next Killers album to arrive in 2027.
